SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. Miscellaneous No. 181.
Sinz a Police Station,
REPORT
Date Nov. 5th, 19 52.
File No. ............

Subject (in full) Anonymous letter 9199/69 29-10-52.

Made by ............ and ............ Forwarded by D.I. Bennett.

Sir,

Re attached anonymous letter, premises No. 10 Taku Road, the Cheng Chi Te Shun Lou Tea-house (貞記得順樓) have been kept under observation by detectives since receipt of letter at the station.

The proprietor of this tea shop, one Woo Ah Tsung (吳阿增) is known to detectives of Sinza Station as of the loafer type, but nothing criminal is known against him.

Nothing suspicious seen regarding the frequenters of this tea-shop, who are the usual type of habituals of such places.

The writer of this letter, Chang Ah Pao (張阿寶) is not known at the Oriental Hotel, the record of the hotel register fails to disclose this man's name as having been a resident of room 509.

Premises personally visited by D.I. Bennett and detectives on the evening of 4-11-52, nothing suspicious seen that would substantiate the allegations in the letter.

It is suspected that a small rear room in this teashop is used for the purpose of gambling, which is probably the reason why the letter was written.

Premises under observation re this gambling.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

D.C. (Crime)
Information
（印：DETECTIVE ... CRIME BR...）
W.A. Kay
D.I.C.B.
4/11/52
（签名：Bennett）
D.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。杂项第 181 号。
新闸捕房，
报告
日期：1952 年 11 月 5 日。
档案号 ____

主题（全称）匿名信 9199/69 1952 年 10 月 29 日。

由 ____ 和 ____ 具报。由警探长 Bennett 转呈。

先生：

关于所附匿名信提及的大沽路 10 号“贞记得顺楼”茶馆，自本捕房收到该信以来，一直由侦探进行监视。

该茶馆店主吴阿增（Woo Ah Tsung），新闸捕房的侦探知其属于游手好闲之徒，但并未掌握其任何犯罪记录。

对该茶馆的常客未观察到可疑情况，这些人均属此类场所常见的惯常顾客。

该信作者张阿宝（Chang Ah Pao）在东方饭店无人知晓，查阅饭店登记簿记录，未发现此人曾入住 509 房间的记录。

1952 年 11 月 4 日晚，警探长 Bennett 及侦探亲自前往该处视察，未发现任何可证实信中指控的可疑情况。

怀疑该茶馆内的一间后侧小房间被用于赌博，这可能就是写此信的原因。

正就赌博一事对该处所进行监视。

此致，
敬礼，

刑事科侦探长
情报
（印章：DETECTIVE ... CRIME BR...）
W.A. Kay
刑事科侦探长
1952 年 11 月 4 日
（签名：Bennett）
警探长
